tools.name: list_codes
tools.description: All dynamic QR codes on the account: id, short link, name, destination, status, scans, smart rules.

tools.name: create_code
tools.description: Create a dynamic QR code that redirects to `destination`. Optional smart rules send some scans elsewhere (first match wins). Returns the short link to print.

tools.name: update_code
tools.description: Change a code's destination, name or smart rules (rules replace the existing list; [] removes them). The owner is emailed about destination and rule changes.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Scans per day, by country and by device type.

tools.name: delete_code
tools.description: Permanently stop a code: anyone scanning it sees 'this code doesn't exist'. Cannot be undone. Only call when the user explicitly asks to delete this code.
